What the record says

  • The Giants' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is underdog of 7 or more (since 2002): 44-32-1 against the spread, a 57.9% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is underdog of 0.5 to 3 (since 2002): 36-39-3, 48.0%.
  • On totals since 2002, the over hits most often when the closing number is under 38 (18-16, 52.9% over) and least often at 45 to 47.5 (36-55-2, 39.6%).
  • All time they have covered 48.8% at home and 52.0% on the road, a 3.2 point edge on the road.
